answers.q1: Cargo (Rust). Install/fetch dependencies with: cargo fetch --locked. Cargo has no separate install step, so dependencies are also fetched automatically by `cargo build --workspace`, which is the CI build command.
answers.q2: cargo test --workspace (CI runs `cargo test --verbose --workspace`, and also variants with `--features pcre2` and `--features unstable-index`).
answers.q3: cargo test --test it regression. tests/regression.rs is a module of the single integration-test target `it` (tests/tests.rs, declared in Cargo.toml), so there is no `--test regression` target. The filter `regression` selects the tests in that module.
answers.q5: Generated, not committed: the man page deployment/deb/rg.1 and the shell completions deployment/deb/rg.bash, rg.fish and _rg. The build process produces them. Also `target/` (build output) and Cargo.lock (maintained by cargo, not by hand). I found no vendored directories.
